authorization: User requests committing prior navigation fix, then repairing an unresponsive board after one long stroke is duplicated15 times and locally erased repeatedly.

owners.derived_damage: RenderGroupManager compares immutable canonical sources and append-only presentation masks; SkiaRenderCache/SkiaRenderer own clips, source residency and retained-pixel validity
owners.platform: Existing supportsPartialUpdate capability; only qualified persistent contents may be reused. WebGL capability must reflect actual preserveDrawingBuffer.
owners.public_api: No JS/DLL business API, schema, identity, operation, version or dependency changes.

evidence_before: 16 long strokes at DPR2: five48-move sweeps each took about8.2s; no permanent deadlock observed in this run. Most CPU samples are full-source rasterization inside SkiaRenderCache::draw.
Native --erase-damage-only uses16 sources and160KiB raster/4KiB entry admission, plus512KiB/128KiB admission. With the former renderer, whole-source rerasterization fails the bounded-work oracle.
implementation_contract: During a continuous append-only sweep, repaint the conservative newly affected device rectangle using the same ordered per-object painter and complete masks. Do not globally clear an ink composite or alter mask/geometry semantics.

Use existing retained source records to validate exact mask prefixes. No hash-only identity, no new canonical document or mask owner; unsupported/non-prefix geometry, source/order/style/overlay changes, camera/target/resource/lifecycle changes, failed present or foreign target force a complete replacement.

Only reuse a successfully presented target that advertises partial updates and still matches provider identity, surface identity/generation/content generation, present count and render-cache sequence. Foreign canvas matrices and host clips (including nonrectangular clips) require complete replacement. No readback or extra framebuffer snapshot.

Reuse only complete resident source images. Cache misses evaluate new body coverage on the existing charged scratch using the original full device sampling grid; evaluate canonical and presentation masks under the original full scratch clip to preserve AA. Clip only body work and destination composition, never store a cropped feedback image as a complete source.

Cache/resource limits remain unchanged. Providers without retained contents, new/changed FilledPath feedback, non-prefix masks or unsupported demand retain full replacement; no silent dropping of effects.

A scratch snapshot/allocation failure retries without presenting incomplete pixels. Damage feedback owns no new persistent framebuffer or canonical state. First feedback and revoked validity use complete replacement. No capacity limit is increased.

This optimization admits destination-independent CompactStroke sources (the supported brush/version profiles). Legacy non-Compact stroke commands keep complete replacement; their historical destination-dependent erase behavior is not redefined.

required: Real Chrome root SDK:16 long strokes,DPR1/2,successive sweeps,motion latency and heartbeat,pre-Up pixels,atomic commits,cancel/Undo/Redo and post-erase navigation.

Native capacity-limited full-image oracle:9 brush/version profiles x2 affine cases x2 cache limits; canonical plus presentation masks, append/tap transition, unchanged feedback, cancel, external target writes, capability fallback, mask-prefix shrink, source/order/resource invalidation, failed presentation and FilledPath fallback; max2 channel AA tolerance. Host clip changes that do not dirty SkSurface contents must also invalidate partial feedback.

Canonical preparation after damage must not reuse incomplete images. Camera/target generations and GPU completion ownership retain their existing render/cache checks; the real consumer verifies repeated erasing followed by two-finger pan/zoom.
Affected erasing/navigation/material/Runtime tests and full native suite; preserve named baseline failures.
verification.measurement: Browser motion times include a real requestAnimationFrame barrier.16-source steady-motion p95 must stay below75ms on this host; separately record cold first-feedback maxima and Up/settlement. Compare premultiplied WebGL pixels composited over the white host: canonical ink-only kClear can legitimately return transparent black, which is not a visible black gap.
